collection.title: VIIRS/JPSS2 Water Reservoir Monthly L3 Global V002
collection.summary: The NOAA-21 Visible Infrared Imaging Radiometer Suite (VIIRS) Water Reservoir Monthly Level 3 (L3) Global (VJ228C3) Version 2 product provides current data for 151 man-made reservoirs and 13 regulated natural lakes for a total of 164 reservoirs. The VJ228C3 data product is a composite of the 8-day area classifications from [VJ228C2](https://doi.org/10.5067/VIIRS/VJ228C2.002) which is converted to provide monthly elevation and water storage. The Lake Temperature and Evaporation Model ([LTEM](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.rse.2020.112104)) with input from VIIRS Land Surface Temperature and Emissivity (VJ221A2) and meteorological data from Global Land Data Assimilation System ([GLDAS](https://earth.gsfc.nasa.gov/hydro/data/gldas-global-land-data-assimilation-system-data)) are used to produce monthly evaporation rates and volume losses. The VJ228C3 data product provides a monthly time series that consists of a single variable with information about the reservoir identifier, dam location (longitude and latitude), reservoir surface area, elevation, water storage capacity, evaporation rate, and evaporation volume. Known Issues * Water occurrence images generally show smaller surface area dynamics in high latitude regions, creating pixels with low occurrence values that have relatively large uncertainties. In addition, the quality of raw water area classification can be affected by lake ice coverage typically creating an overestimation of surface area in the enhancement algorithm. This issue will be addressed in a future release of the enhancement algorithm. For additional information about known issues, refer to Section 4 in the User Guide.

documentation.description: The technical information in the User's Guide enables users to interpret and use the data products.
The LDOPE Land Product Quality Assessment website provides known issues, maneuvers, and product quality of the land products.
Validation at stage 1 has been achieved for the VIIRS Global Water Reservoir product suite.
Further details regarding VIIRS product validation and maturity status are available from VIIRS Land Product Quality Assessment site.
The ATBD provides physical theory and mathematical procedures for the calculations used to produce the data products.
